briefing.text: France’s budget impasse is sharpening: a law rolling over the previous budget is being presented as the only credible way to maintain continuity, while passage of the 2027 budget this year is considered unlikely.

sources.title: Philippe Brun : « Le budget 2027 ne sera pas adopté cette année. Plutôt que d’entretenir une fiction, il faut nommer le blocage et organiser la sortie de crise »

briefing.text: Eight countries, including France and the UK, are calling for Palestinian presidential and legislative elections in the first quarter of 2027, saying free elections are essential to democratic principles.

sources.title: Palestine : huit pays, dont la France et le Royaume-Uni, appellent à l’organisation d’élections présidentielle et législatives « au premier trimestre 2027 »

briefing.text: A Reuters report says Trump-backed World Liberty’s crypto token fell about 50% overnight, a notable shock in the politically linked crypto market.
